title: A synthetic stock event stream
method: Illustrative reducer: 20 − 5 + 2 − 4 = 13 units, applied in the declared event order. Values are states after each accepted transition, not sales observations. External side effects are excluded during replay.
alt: A synthetic stock event stream. Initial stock: 20 units; Reserve five: 15 units; Release two: 17 units; Reserve four: 13 units. Illustrative inputs.
